```{r Graphical theme}
theme_my <- function(base_size = 11, base_family = "TT Arial")
{
  txt <- element_text(size = base_size, colour = "black", face = "bold")
  bold_txt <- element_text(size = base_size, colour = "black", face = "bold")

  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
  theme(
    legend.key = element_blank(), 
    strip.background = element_blank(), 

    text = txt, 
    plot.title = txt,

    axis.title = txt,
    axis.text = txt, 

    legend.title = bold_txt, 
    legend.text = txt,legend.position = "right" ) 
}
```

### Data loading, pre-processing and integration

<br>

In this script, we processed single-cell transcriptomic data from the TICIMEL and MELANF projects using the Seurat package, along with ggplot2, stringr, and clustree. We first located and loaded the .h5 files containing the filtered expression matrices with Read10X_h5, then created a Seurat object for each sample, calculated the percentage of mitochondrial genes, and generated quality control plots such as violin plots and scatter plots. We applied a custom filtering strategy, using thresholds specific to each sample for the number of detected genes and the proportion of mitochondrial genes, and visually inspected the results. We then merged all datasets into a single object after renaming the cells, performed normalization, PCA, UMAP, and initial clustering. To correct for batch effects, we used the CCA integration method (IntegrateLayers) and carried out multi-resolution clustering, visualized with clustree, to compare results before and after integration. Finally, we merged the data layers (JoinLayers) and saved the final integrated object in .rds format, along with all the figures generated throughout the workflow.

```{r eval=FALSE}
#Files loading
filesT <- list.files("/home/matthieu/Desktop/Etienne_SC/TICIMEL/DATA/TICIMEL/", all.files = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE, pattern = "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
NameSamplesT <- str_extract(filesT, "T\\d+_S\\d+")


filesM <- list.files("/home/matthieu/Desktop/Etienne_SC/TICIMEL/DATA/MELANF/", all.files = TRUE, full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE, pattern = "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
NameSamplesM <- str_extract(filesM, "M\\d+_S\\d+")


NameSamples <- c(NameSamplesT, NameSamplesM)

files <- c(filesT,filesM)

# Quality check and filtering
QC_Seurat_Patient <- function(files, NameSamples) {
  seurat_objects <- list()
  output_dir <- "/home/matthieu/Desktop/Etienne_SC/UNIFICATION_TICIMEL_MELANF/Figures/Pre-Processing/"
  for (i in 1:length(files)) {
    print(paste("Processing:", NameSamples[i]))
    
    expression_data <- Read10X_h5(files[i])
    
    if (class(expression_data) == "list") {
      expression_data <- expression_data$`Gene Expression`
    }
    
    seurat_object <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = expression_data, project = NameSamples[i])
    
    seurat_object[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(seurat_object, pattern = "^MT-")
    
    seurat_objects[[i]] <- seurat_object
    
    vln_plot <- VlnPlot(seurat_object, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3) + 
      ggtitle(paste("Patient:", NameSamples[i])) + 
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
    
    scatter1 <- FeatureScatter(seurat_object, feature1 = "nFeature_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt") +
      ggtitle(paste("Feature vs Mitochondrial Percentage:", NameSamples[i])) + 
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),) + theme_bw()
    
    scatter2 <- FeatureScatter(seurat_object, feature1 = "nCount_RNA", feature2 = "nFeature_RNA") +
      ggtitle(paste("Counts vs Features:", NameSamples[i])) + 
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) + theme_bw()
    
    ggsave(filename = paste0(output_dir, "/", NameSamples[i], "_vln_plot.png"), plot = vln_plot, width = 8, height = 4)
    ggsave(filename = paste0(output_dir, "/", NameSamples[i], "_scatter1.png"), plot = scatter1, width = 8, height = 4)
    ggsave(filename = paste0(output_dir, "/", NameSamples[i], "_scatter2.png"), plot = scatter2, width = 8, height = 4)
    
  }
  return(seurat_objects)
}

pbmc <- QC_Seurat_Patient(files, NameSamples)

#Tresholds application
for (i in 1:length(pbmc)) {
  print(paste("Filtering patient:", i))
  
  min_features <- thresholds[[i]]$min_features
  max_features <- thresholds[[i]]$max_features
  max_percent_mt <- thresholds[[i]]$max_percent_mt
  
  pbmc[[i]] <- subset(pbmc[[i]], subset = nFeature_RNA > min_features & nFeature_RNA < max_features & percent.mt < max_percent_mt)
}


#Post-Filtering Check
for (i in 1:length(pbmc)) {
  print(paste("Generating scatter plot for patient:", i))
  
  scatter_plot <- FeatureScatter(pbmc[[i]], feature1 = "nFeature_RNA", feature2 = "percent.mt") +
    ggtitle(paste("Patient", NameSamples[i], ": Percent.mt vs nFeature_RNA after filtering")) + 
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) + 
    theme_bw()  
  print(scatter_plot)
  
  ggsave(filename = paste0("/home/matthieu/Desktop/Etienne_SC/UNIFICATION_TICIMEL_MELANF/Figures/Pre-Processing/filtered/patient_", NameSamples[i], "_scatter_plot.png"), 
         plot = scatter_plot, width = 8, height = 4)
}


#MERGING AND INTEGRATION
#Merging
for (i in 1:length(pbmc)) {
  pbmc[[i]] <- RenameCells(pbmc[[i]], new.names = paste0(NameSamples[i], "_", colnames(pbmc[[i]])))
}

count_matrices <- lapply(pbmc, function(x) GetAssayData(x, slot = "counts"))

merged_matrix <- Seurat::RowMergeSparseMatrices(count_matrices[[1]], count_matrices[-1])

pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = merged_matrix, project = "Merged_Seurat")

pbmc[["RNA"]] <- split(pbmc[["RNA"]], f = pbmc$orig.ident)

# Pre integration Test
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc)
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc)
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc)
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca")
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 2, cluster.name = "unintegrated_clusters")

pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:30, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")
P1 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", group.by = "orig.ident", label = TRUE)
```

### Adding the ADT layer (Protein information) and other metadatas

```{r eval=FALSE}
Pipeline_Protein_Seurat <- function(pbmc, Patient_Protein_Files, NameSamples){
  require(tidyverse)
  
  ### Loading Protein files:
  myfxn <- function(i, p, n){
    patient = n[i]
    P1 = Seurat::Read10X_h5(p[i])
    P1 = as.data.frame(P1$`Antibody Capture`)
    if (patient %in% c("T1_S1", "T1_S6")) {
      colnames(P1) = "CD4.1"
      P1 = t(P1)
    }
    colnames(P1) = paste0(patient, "-", colnames(P1))
    rownames(P1) = str_replace(rownames(P1), pattern = fixed(".1"), "")
    P1 = P1 %>% as.data.frame()
    
    # Renaming for specific cases
    rownames(P1)[rownames(P1) == "CD14_3G8"] = "CD16"
    rownames(P1)[rownames(P1) == "CD14_M5E2"] = "CD14"
    P1$id = rownames(P1)
    
    return(P1)
  }
  
  print("Loading all CellRanger objects")
  Protein = pbmcapply::pbmclapply(1:length(Patient_Protein_Files),
                                   FUN = myfxn,
                                   n = NameSamples,
                                   p = Patient_Protein_Files,
                                   mc.cores = 12, mc.style = "ETA")
  
  print("Merging all Datasets")
  Protein = Protein %>% purrr::reduce(merge, by = "id", all = TRUE) %>% column_to_rownames("id")
  
  print("Creating Seurat Object")
  print(head(colnames(pbmc)))
  print(head(colnames(Protein)))
  print(dim(Protein))
  print(head(Protein))
  print(dim(pbmc))
  print(head(pbmc))
  
  # Normalisation des noms de cellules
  colnames(pbmc) <- gsub("T1_S1-", "", colnames(pbmc))  
  colnames(pbmc) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(pbmc))
  colnames(Protein) <- gsub("-", "_", colnames(Protein))
  
  print("Noms de cellules dans pbmc :")
print(head(colnames(pbmc), 20))  

print("Noms de cellules dans Protein :")
print(head(colnames(Protein), 20))

  common_cells <- intersect(colnames(pbmc), colnames(Protein))
  if (length(common_cells) == 0) {
    stop("No common cells found between pbmc and Protein. Please check the cell names.")
  }
  
  print(paste("Nombre de cellules communes :", length(common_cells)))
  
  pbmc = pbmc[, colnames(pbmc) %in% common_cells]
  
  adt_counts <- Protein[, colnames(Protein) %in% common_cells]
  pbmc[["ADT"]] = Seurat::CreateAssayObject(counts = adt_counts)
  
  return(pbmc)
}

pbmctest = Pipeline_Protein_Seurat(pbmc = pbmctest, Patient_Protein_Files = files, NameSamples = NameSamples)

pbmctest[["ADT"]]@counts[is.na(pbmctest[["ADT"]]@counts)] <- 0
pbmctest[["ADT"]]@data[is.na(pbmctest[["ADT"]]@data)] <- 0

pbmctest@meta.data$nCount_ADT <- Matrix::colSums(pbmctest@assays$ADT@counts)
summary(pbmctest@meta.data$nCount_ADT)

pbmctest@meta.data$log_umi <- log1p(pbmctest@meta.data$nCount_ADT)
any(is.na(pbmctest@meta.data$log_umi) | is.nan(pbmctest@meta.data$log_umi) | is.infinite(pbmctest@meta.data$log_umi))

DefaultAssay(pbmctest) <- 'ADT'

VariableFeatures(pbmctest) <- rownames(pbmctest[["ADT"]])
pbmctest <- NormalizeData(pbmctest, normalization.method = 'CLR', margin = 2,) %>% 
  ScaleData() %>% RunPCA(reduction.name = 'apca')

pbmc <- pbmctest

DefaultAssay(pbmc) <- "ADT"

P1 <- FeaturePlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap.cca", features = Features(pbmc))
ggsave(filename = "Protéines.png",plot = P1,path = "/home/matthieu/Desktop/Etienne_SC/UNIFICATION_TICIMEL_MELANF/PBMC/Figures/", width = 30,height = 20)


pbmc@meta.data$Week <- ifelse(grepl("S1", rownames(pbmc@meta.data)), "S1", 
                              ifelse(grepl("S6", rownames(pbmc@meta.data)), "S6", NA))

pbmc@meta.data$Traitement <- ifelse(
  grepl("\\bT1\\b|\\bT3\\b|\\bT5\\b|\\bT9\\b|\\bT23\\b|\\bT24\\b|\\bT26\\b|\\bT32\\b", pbmc@meta.data$orig.ident), 
  "Certolizumab",
  ifelse(
    grepl("\\bT2\\b|\\bT12\\b|\\bT6\\b|\\bT10\\b|\\bT14\\b|\\bT22\\b|\\bT25\\b|\\bT28\\b", pbmc@meta.data$orig.ident), 
    "Infliximab", 
    "Ipi-Nivo"
  )
)

pbmc@meta.data$Reponse <- ifelse(grepl("\\bT1\\b|\\bT3\\b|\\bT6\\b|\\bT9\\b|\\bT10\\b|\\bT12\\b|\\bT23\\b|\\bT28\\b|\\bM13\\b|\\bM17\\b|\\bM26\\b|\\bM34\\b", pbmc@meta.data$orig.ident), "R",
                                 ifelse(grepl("\\bT2\\b|\\bT5\\b|\\bT14\\b|\\bT22\\b|\\bT24\\b|\\bT25\\b|\\bT26\\b|\\bT32\\b|\\bM16\\b|\\bM25\\b|\\bM28\\b|\\bM42\\b", pbmc@meta.data$orig.ident), "NR", NA))


cell_names <- rownames(pbmc@meta.data)

pbmc@meta.data$Name <- sapply(strsplit(cell_names, "_"), function(x) paste(x[1:2], collapse = "_"))

pbmc@meta.data$Name <- paste(pbmc@meta.data$Name, pbmc$Reponse, sep = "_")

pbmc$Cluster_Rep <- paste(pbmc$Reponse, pbmc$Week, sep = "_")
```

## Gating Strategy for CD4/CD8 with Single Cell Signature Explorer

(F.Pont <https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkz601>)

<br>

In this script we chosed not to follow the basic clustering way to discriminate the subpopulations of pbmc cells. Indeed we based ourselves on the Single Cell Signature Explorer tool that allows the inference of a score for each and every cell based on handmade signatures. Then with the merger we combined the scores and the coordinates of the UMAP in order to use the last tool : the virtual cytometer. We used a classical gating strategy to find appropriate tresholds to discriminate the subpopulations.

![VIRTUAL CYTOMETER](VirtualCyto.png) 

<br>

<br>

As explained in the article we picked the cluster 2 for the next analysis. The next script shows the evolution of the proportions of cells of this cluster between Week 0 and 6 for each treatment.

```{r Fig.2.e, fig.width=9, fig.height=2, warning=F}
CD8 <- readRDS("/home/etienne.leclercq/Bureau/Etienne_SC/UNIFICATION_TICIMEL_MELANF/DATA/CD8_SCSE.rds")

CD8$Cluster_Rep <- paste(CD8$Reponse, CD8$Week, sep = "_")
CD8$Traitement_Week <- paste(CD8$Traitement, CD8$Week, sep = "_")

ppt <- CD8@meta.data %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Name, cca_clusters, Cluster_Rep, Traitement) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Name, Cluster_Rep,Traitement) %>%
  summarise(freq = n / sum(n), cca_clusters) %>%
  as.data.frame()

ppt <- ppt %>%
  mutate(Type = case_when(
    cca_clusters == 2 ~ "Cluster2"))

ppt$Traitement_Cluster <- paste0(ppt$Traitement, "_", ppt$cca_clusters)

ppt$Traitement_Cluster <- factor(ppt$Traitement_Cluster, levels = c(
  "Certolizumab_2", "Infliximab_2", "Ipi-Nivo_2"))

ppt$group <- substr(ppt$Name, 1, 3)
ppt <- dplyr::mutate(ppt, Patient = as.factor(group))

ppt <- drop_na(ppt)

color_map <- c(
  "Certolizumab" = "#5f4a95",
  "Infliximab"  = "#4570b6",
  "Ipi-Nivo"    = "#46b9ab"
)

all_plots <- list()

for (cluster in unique(ppt$cca_clusters)) {
  for (traitement in unique(ppt$Traitement)) {
    
    filtered_data <- ppt %>%
      filter(cca_clusters == cluster & Traitement == traitement)
    
    filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
      mutate(Cluster_Rep_Simplified = case_when(
        str_detect(Cluster_Rep, "S1") ~ "S1",
        str_detect(Cluster_Rep, "S6") ~ "S6",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )) %>%
      filter(!is.na(Cluster_Rep_Simplified))
    
    p_value <- if (all(c("S1", "S6") %in% filtered_data$Cluster_Rep_Simplified)) {
      wilcox.test(
        filtered_data$freq[filtered_data$Cluster_Rep_Simplified == "S1"],
        filtered_data$freq[filtered_data$Cluster_Rep_Simplified == "S6"],
        exact = FALSE
      )$p.value
    } else {
      NA
    }
    
    title <- paste0("Cluster ", cluster, " - ", traitement, ": ", 
                    ifelse(!is.na(p_value) & p_value < 0.05, "*", "ns"))
    
    plot <- ggplot(filtered_data, aes(
      x = Cluster_Rep_Simplified,
      y = freq,
      color = Traitement,     
      group = Patient         
    )) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_line() +
      scale_color_manual(values = color_map) +  
      labs(title = title, x = "Cluster Rep (Simplified)", y = "Frequency") +
      ylim(0, 0.4) +
      theme_my() +
      theme(legend.position = "none")
    
    all_plots[[paste0("Cluster_", cluster, "_", traitement)]] <- plot
  }
}

combined_plot <- wrap_plots(all_plots, ncol = 4)

print(combined_plot)


```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
               c("3_Ipi-Nivo_S6","3_Ipi-Nivo_S1"),
               c("4_Certolizumab_S6","4_Certolizumab_S1"),
               c("4_Infliximab_S6","4_Infliximab_S1"),
               c("4_Ipi-Nivo_S6","4_Ipi-Nivo_S1"),
               c("5_Certolizumab_S6","5_Certolizumab_S1"),
               c("5_Infliximab_S6","5_Infliximab_S1"),
               c("5_Ipi-Nivo_S6","5_Ipi-Nivo_S1"),
               c("6_Certolizumab_S6","6_Certolizumab_S1"),
               c("6_Infliximab_S6","6_Infliximab_S1"),
               c("6_Ipi-Nivo_S6","6_Ipi-Nivo_S1"),
               c("7_Certolizumab_S6","7_Certolizumab_S1"),
               c("7_Infliximab_S6","7_Infliximab_S1"),
               c("7_Ipi-Nivo_S6","7_Ipi-Nivo_S1"))


for(condi in condition){
  Idents(pbmc)=pbmc$condition

marks=FindMarkers(pbmc,ident.1 =condi[[1]],ident.2 = condi[2:length(condi)] ) %>% rownames_to_column("Gene") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj<0.01,(pct.1>0.2|pct.2>0.2),abs(avg_log2FC)>0.5) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(diff=pct.1-pct.2)
  
bgset=rownames(pbmc)[rowSums(pbmc[["RNA"]]$counts)>0]

pp=lapply(Pathways, function(x){
  
  pathways.hallmark <- fgsea::gmtPathways(x)

  
  orr=fgsea::fora(pathways = pathways.hallmark,genes=marks$Gene,universe = bgset) %>% dplyr::filter(padj<0.01) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-overlapGenes)
  

  return(orr)

})

pp <- lapply(Pathways, function(x) {
  pathways <- fgsea::gmtPathways(x)
  fgsea::fora(pathways = pathways,
              genes    = marks$Gene,
              universe = bgset) %>%
    filter(padj < 0.01)
})

dat <- bind_rows(pp) %>%
  arrange(padj)

plt <- dat %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  
  mutate(
    geneList = overlapGenes %>%
      str_remove_all("^c\\(") %>%      
      str_remove_all("\\)$") %>%       
      str_remove_all('\\"') %>%        
      str_split(",\\s*")               
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    overlapPos = map(geneList, ~ keep(.x,  ~ {
      idx <- match(.x, marks$Gene)
      !is.na(idx) && marks$avg_log2FC[idx] > 0
    })),
    overlapNeg = map(geneList, ~ keep(.x,  ~ {
      idx <- match(.x, marks$Gene)
      !is.na(idx) && marks$avg_log2FC[idx] < 0
    }))
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    overlapGenes = map_chr(geneList, paste, collapse = ";"),
    overlapPos   = map_chr(overlapPos,   paste, collapse = ";"),
    overlapNeg   = map_chr(overlapNeg,   paste, collapse = ";")
  ) %>%
  
  arrange(padj) %>%
  mutate(
    pathway   = factor(pathway, levels = rev(pathway)),
    rank      = row_number(),
    GeneRatio = overlap / size
  )

plt_to_export <- plt %>% 
  dplyr::select(-geneList)

stopifnot(all(!map_lgl(plt_to_export, is.list)))

write.table(plt_to_export,file      = paste0(path_figures, "/ORA_RESULTS_", condi[[1]], "_vs_", condi[[2]], ".txt"),  quote     = FALSE,  sep       = "\t",  row.names = FALSE)
  
}
  

```

<br>

In this script, we analyzed pathway enrichment for the CD8 population across the three treatments. We loaded the enrichment results, standardized the values, and combined them with curated pathway collections from MSigDB to build a common reference. From each condition we selected the top enriched pathways, calculated fold-enrichment scores relative to the CD8 gene universe, and normalized the results for comparability. Finally, we visualized the data as a comparative bar plot.

```{r Fig.2.f, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 12}
  left_join(pathway_theoretical_sizes, by = "pathway") %>%
  mutate(N = N)

  mutate(
    x = as.numeric(overlap), 
    M = as.numeric(size)     
  ) %>%
  mutate(FE = (x / k) / (M / N))

  dplyr::select(pathway, Traitement, Classe, FE)

pathways_with_classes <- dat_radar %>%
  distinct(pathway, Classe) %>%
  arrange(Classe, pathway)

ordered_pathways <- pathways_with_classes$pathway

df_radar_wide <- dat_radar %>%
  dplyr::select(pathway, Traitement, FE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = pathway, values_from = FE) %>%
  rename(group = Traitement)

df_radar_wide <- df_radar_wide %>%
  mutate(across(-group, ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))

cols_to_transform_and_normalize <- names(df_radar_wide)[names(df_radar_wide) != "group"]

df_radar_transformed_normalized <- df_radar_wide %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cols_to_transform_and_normalize), ~ {
    transformed_values <- log2(. + 1) 
    
    min_val_transformed <- 0
    max_val_transformed <- max(transformed_values, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    if (min_val_transformed == max_val_transformed) {
      return(0.5)
    } else {
      return((transformed_values - min_val_transformed) / (max_val_transformed - min_val_transformed))
    }
  }))

df_radar_final <- df_radar_transformed_normalized %>%
  dplyr::select(group, all_of(ordered_pathways))

    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

print(plot_radar_values)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
dat2_raw <- read.csv("/home/etienne.leclercq/Bureau/Etienne_SC/UNIFICATION_TICIMEL_MELANF/POST-SCSE/CD8/FIGURES/PROGENY_Et_Autres/ORA_pct_02/RES_ORA/ORA_RESULTS_2_Infliximab_S6_vs_2_Infliximab_S1.txt",sep ="")
dat3_raw <- read.csv("/home/etienne.leclercq/Bureau/Etienne_SC/UNIFICATION_TICIMEL_MELANF/POST-SCSE/CD8/FIGURES/PROGENY_Et_Autres/ORA_pct_02/RES_ORA/ORA_RESULTS_2_Ipi-Nivo_S6_vs_2_Ipi-Nivo_S1.txt",sep ="")

dat1_processed <- list_dat_processed[[1]]

Pathways_gmt_files <- c(
  "/home/etienne.leclercq/Bureau/Etienne_SC/UNIFICATION_TICIMEL_MELANF/DATA/pathways/h.all.v2024.1.Hs.symbols.gmt",
  "/home/etienne.leclercq/Bureau/Etienne_SC/UNIFICATION_TICIMEL_MELANF/DATA/pathways/c2.cp.reactome.v2024.1.Hs.symbols.gmt",

dat <- full_combinations_for_radar %>%

dat <- na.omit(dat)

unique_classes <- unique(dat$Classe)

for (current_class in unique_classes) {
  message(paste0("Traitement de la classe : ", current_class))

  all_top_pathways_for_class <- dat %>%
    filter(Classe == current_class)

  all_genes_for_class <- all_top_pathways_for_class %>%
    pull(overlapGenes) %>%
    str_split(";") %>%
    unlist() %>%
    unique() %>%
    as.character()

  genes_to_analyze_current_class <- all_genes_for_class[all_genes_for_class %in% rownames(CD8@assays$RNA$data)]

  if (length(genes_to_analyze_current_class) == 0) {
    warning(paste0("Aucun gène de la classe '", current_class, "' n'a été trouvé dans l'objet Seurat. Skipping cette classe."))
    next 
  }

  logFC_patient_gene_data <- tibble()
  patients_unique <- unique(CD8@meta.data$orig.ident) 
  
  for (patient_id in patients_unique) {
    cells_s1 <- rownames(CD8@meta.data %>% filter(orig.ident == patient_id, Week == "S1"))
    cells_s6 <- rownames(CD8@meta.data %>% filter(orig.ident == patient_id, Week == "S6"))


    if (length(cells_s1) > 0 && length(cells_s6) > 0) {
      expr_s1 <- Seurat::GetAssayData(CD8, slot = "data")[genes_to_analyze_current_class, cells_s1, drop = FALSE]
      expr_s6 <- Seurat::GetAssayData(CD8, slot = "data")[genes_to_analyze_current_class, cells_s6, drop = FALSE]

      if(nrow(expr_s1) == 0 || nrow(expr_s6) == 0) {
          warning(paste0("Pas de données d'expression pour les gènes de la classe '", current_class, "' pour le patient ", patient_id, ". Skipping patient."))
          next
      }

      mean_expr_s1 <- rowMeans(expr_s1)
      mean_expr_s6 <- rowMeans(expr_s6)

      logFC_val <- mean_expr_s6 / mean_expr_s1 

      patient_treatment <- CD8@meta.data %>%
        filter(orig.ident == patient_id) %>%
        dplyr::pull(Traitement) %>%
        unique()

      if (length(patient_treatment) == 1) {
        temp_df <- tibble(
          Gene = genes_to_analyze_current_class,
          Patient = patient_id,
          Traitement = patient_treatment,
          LogFC_S6_S1 = logFC_val
        )
        logFC_patient_gene_data <- bind_rows(logFC_patient_gene_data, temp_df)
      } else {
        warning(paste("Problème avec le traitement du patient:", patient_id, ". Plusieurs ou aucun traitement trouvé."))
      }
    } else {
      warning(paste("Données S1 ou S6 manquantes ou insuffisantes pour le patient:", patient_id, ". Patient ignoré pour l'analyse des logFC."))
    }
  }

  if (nrow(logFC_patient_gene_data) == 0) {
    warning(paste0("Aucune donnée de logFC n'a pu être calculée pour la classe '", current_class, "'. Skipping cette classe."))
    next
  }

  mean_logFC_by_treatment <- logFC_patient_gene_data %>%
    group_by(Gene, Traitement) %>%
    summarise(Mean_LogFC = mean(LogFC_S6_S1, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Traitement, values_from = Mean_LogFC,
                names_prefix = "Mean_LogFC_") 

  logFC_by_patient <- logFC_patient_gene_data %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene, Patient, LogFC_S6_S1) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Patient, values_from = LogFC_S6_S1,
                names_prefix = "LogFC_Patient_")

  treatments <- unique(logFC_patient_gene_data$Traitement)
  comparison_pairs <- combn(treatments, 2, simplify = FALSE)

  p_value_results <- tibble(Gene = genes_to_analyze_current_class)

  for (gene in genes_to_analyze_current_class) {
    gene_data <- logFC_patient_gene_data %>% filter(Gene == gene)

    for (pair in comparison_pairs) {
      trt1 <- pair[1]
      trt2 <- pair[2]

      data_trt1 <- gene_data %>% filter(Traitement == trt1) %>% pull(LogFC_S6_S1)
      data_trt2 <- gene_data %>% filter(Traitement == trt2) %>% pull(LogFC_S6_S1)

      col_name <- paste0("P_Value_Wilcoxon_", trt1, "_vs_", trt2)

      if (length(data_trt1[!is.na(data_trt1)]) > 1 && length(data_trt2[!is.na(data_trt2)]) > 1) {
        test_result <- wilcox.test(data_trt1, data_trt2)
        p_value_results[p_value_results$Gene == gene, col_name] <- test_result$p.value
      } else {
        p_value_results[p_value_results$Gene == gene, col_name] <- NA
      }
    }
  }

  # Tableau final
  final_table <- mean_logFC_by_treatment %>%
    left_join(logFC_by_patient, by = "Gene") %>%
    left_join(p_value_results, by = "Gene") %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene, starts_with("Mean_LogFC_"), starts_with("LogFC_Patient_"), starts_with("P_Value_Wilcoxon_"))

  # Export (ajout _bis)
  output_filename <- paste0("Resume_Genes_", current_class, "_Comparaisons_Traitements_C2.xlsx")
  write.xlsx(final_table, file.path(path_figures, output_filename), rowNames = FALSE)

  message(paste("✅ Tableau exporté pour la classe '", current_class, "' :", file.path(path_figures, output_filename)))
}
```

<br>

In this script, we focused on identifying and visualizing genes that significantly differ between treatments within the CD8 population. We first loaded pre-processed gene tables grouped into functional classes such as interferon, cytokine, immune deficiency, MHC-related, and others. From each dataset, we extracted genes with significant differential expression across treatment comparisons, then combined them into a unified gene set. For each patient, we calculated the difference in mean expression between week S6 and S1, creating a matrix of log fold changes. After filtering and ordering patients by treatment and clustering, we generated a heatmap scaled by Z-scores.

```{r Fig.2.g, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 14}
CD8 <- readRDS("/home/etienne.leclercq/Bureau/Etienne_SC/UNIFICATION_TICIMEL_MELANF/DATA/CD8_SCSE.rds")
datIFN <- read.xlsx("/home/etienne.leclercq/Bureau/Etienne_SC/UNIFICATION_TICIMEL_MELANF/FIGURES_PAPIER/Tableaux genes du radarplot/Resume_Genes_IFN_Comparaisons_Traitements.xlsx", sheetIndex = 1)
datCYT <- read.xlsx("/home/etienne.leclercq/Bureau/Etienne_SC/UNIFICATION_TICIMEL_MELANF/FIGURES_PAPIER/Tableaux genes du radarplot/Resume_Genes_CYTOKINE_Comparaisons_Traitements.xlsx", sheetIndex = 1)
datIMM <- read.xlsx("/home/etienne.leclercq/Bureau/Etienne_SC/UNIFICATION_TICIMEL_MELANF/FIGURES_PAPIER/Tableaux genes du radarplot/Resume_Genes_ImmuneDef_Comparaisons_Traitements.xlsx", sheetIndex = 1)
datOTH <- read.xlsx("/home/etienne.leclercq/Bureau/Etienne_SC/UNIFICATION_TICIMEL_MELANF/FIGURES_PAPIER/Tableaux genes du radarplot/Resume_Genes_Other_Comparaisons_Traitements.xlsx", sheetIndex = 1)

  pull(Gene)

  pull(Gene)
genesCYT2 <- datCYT %>%
  filter(P_Value_Wilcoxon_Certolizumab_vs_Ipi.Nivo < 0.05) %>%
  pull(Gene)
genesCYT3 <- datCYT %>%
  filter(P_Value_Wilcoxon_Infliximab_vs_Ipi.Nivo < 0.05) %>%
  pull(Gene)
genesIMM1 <- datIMM %>%
  filter(P_Value_Wilcoxon_Certolizumab_vs_Infliximab < 0.05) %>%
  pull(Gene)
genesIMM2 <- datIMM %>%
  filter(P_Value_Wilcoxon_Certolizumab_vs_Ipi.Nivo < 0.05) %>%

  filter(P_Value_Wilcoxon_Infliximab_vs_Ipi.Nivo < 0.05) %>%
  pull(Gene)
genesMHC1 <- datMHC %>%
  filter(P_Value_Wilcoxon_Certolizumab_vs_Infliximab < 0.05) %>%
  pull(Gene)

  filter(P_Value_Wilcoxon_Certolizumab_vs_Ipi.Nivo < 0.05) %>%

  filter(P_Value_Wilcoxon_Infliximab_vs_Ipi.Nivo < 0.05) %>%

  filter(P_Value_Wilcoxon_Certolizumab_vs_Infliximab < 0.05) %>%
  pull(Gene)
genesOTH2 <- datOTH %>%
  filter(P_Value_Wilcoxon_Certolizumab_vs_Ipi.Nivo < 0.05) %>%
  pull(Gene)
genesOTH3 <- datOTH %>%
  filter(P_Value_Wilcoxon_Infliximab_vs_Ipi.Nivo < 0.05) %>%
  pull(Gene)

all_genes <- union(genesIFN1, genesIFN2)
all_genes <- union(all_genes, genesIFN3)
all_genes <- union(all_genes, genesCYT1)
all_genes <- union(all_genes, genesCYT2)
all_genes <- union(all_genes, genesCYT3)
all_genes <- union(all_genes, genesIMM1)
all_genes <- union(all_genes, genesIMM2)
all_genes <- union(all_genes, genesIMM3)
all_genes <- union(all_genes, genesMHC1)

all_genes <- union(all_genes, genesOTH2)

CD8_expr <- as.data.frame(Seurat::GetAssayData(CD8, slot = "data"))
CD8_meta <- CD8@meta.data %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("barcode")

patients <- unique(CD8_meta$orig.ident)

genes_for_heatmap <- all_genes[all_genes %in% rownames(CD8_expr)]

heatmap_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = length(genes_for_heatmap), ncol = length(patients),
                         dimnames = list(genes_for_heatmap, patients))

for (patient_id in patients) {
  patient_cells_meta <- CD8_meta %>%
    filter(orig.ident == patient_id)

  s1_cells <- patient_cells_meta %>% filter(Week == "S1") %>% pull(barcode)
  s6_cells <- patient_cells_meta %>% filter(Week == "S6") %>% pull(barcode)

  if (length(s1_cells) > 0 && length(s6_cells) > 0) {
    mean_expr_s1 <- rowMeans(CD8_expr[genes_for_heatmap, s1_cells, drop = FALSE])
    mean_expr_s6 <- rowMeans(CD8_expr[genes_for_heatmap, s6_cells, drop = FALSE])

    ratio_s6_s1_values <- mean_expr_s6 - mean_expr_s1
    heatmap_matrix[, patient_id] <- ratio_s6_s1_values
  } else {
    warning(paste("Données S1 ou S6 manquantes ou insuffisantes pour le patient:", patient_id, ". Ce patient sera omis ou aura des NAs."))
  }
}

heatmap_matrix[is.infinite(heatmap_matrix)] <- NA
heatmap_matrix[is.na(heatmap_matrix)] <- 0

heatmap_matrix_clean <- heatmap_matrix[, colSums(is.na(heatmap_matrix)) < nrow(heatmap_matrix), drop = FALSE]

if (ncol(heatmap_matrix_clean) == 0 || nrow(heatmap_matrix_clean) == 0) {

  tibble::rownames_to_column("barcode_column") %>%

  tibble::column_to_rownames("orig.ident")

annotation_patient_df_clean$Traitement <- factor(annotation_patient_df_clean$Traitement, levels = desired_treatment_order)

desired_response_order <- c("R", "NR")
annotation_patient_df_clean$Reponse <- factor(annotation_patient_df_clean$Reponse, levels = desired_response_order)

ordered_patient_ids_final <- c()

for (treatment in desired_treatment_order) {
  patients_in_treatment <- rownames(annotation_patient_df_clean[annotation_patient_df_clean$Traitement == treatment, , drop = FALSE])

  if (length(patients_in_treatment) > 1) {
    sub_matrix <- heatmap_matrix_clean[, patients_in_treatment, drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(sub_matrix) > 0 && ncol(sub_matrix) > 0 && var(as.vector(sub_matrix), na.rm = TRUE) > 1e-9) {
      dist_patients <- dist(t(sub_matrix))
      hc_patients <- hclust(dist_patients)
      ordered_patient_ids_final <- c(ordered_patient_ids_final, hc_patients$labels[hc_patients$order])
    } else {
        ordered_patient_ids_final <- c(ordered_patient_ids_final, patients_in_treatment[order(patients_in_treatment)])
    }
  } else if (length(patients_in_treatment) == 1) {
    ordered_patient_ids_final <- c(ordered_patient_ids_final, patients_in_treatment)
  }
}

heatmap_matrix_ordered <- heatmap_matrix_clean[, ordered_patient_ids_final, drop = FALSE]

annotation_patient_df_ordered <- annotation_patient_df_clean[ordered_patient_ids_final, , drop = FALSE]

all_p_values_df <- bind_rows(

  datIMM %>% dplyr::select(Gene, starts_with("P_Value_Wilcoxon_")),
  datMHC %>% dplyr::select(Gene, starts_with("P_Value_Wilcoxon_")),
  datOTH %>% dplyr::select(Gene, starts_with("P_Value_Wilcoxon_"))
) %>%
  distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE) 

genes_in_heatmap <- rownames(heatmap_matrix_ordered)
annotation_gene_df <- data.frame(row.names = genes_in_heatmap)

create_significance_column <- function(data_p_values, p_value_col_name, genes_to_annotate, threshold = 0.05) {
  sig_vector <- rep(FALSE, length(genes_to_annotate))
  names(sig_vector) <- genes_to_annotate

  significant_genes_from_source <- data_p_values %>%
    filter(get(p_value_col_name) < threshold) %>%
    pull(Gene)

  sig_vector[genes_to_annotate %in% significant_genes_from_source] <- TRUE

  return(sig_vector)
}

annotation_gene_df$`Sig. Certo vs Inflix` <- create_significance_column(
  all_p_values_df, "P_Value_Wilcoxon_Certolizumab_vs_Infliximab", genes_in_heatmap
)

annotation_gene_df$`Sig. Certo vs Ipi-Nivo` <- create_significance_column(
  all_p_values_df, "P_Value_Wilcoxon_Certolizumab_vs_Ipi.Nivo", genes_in_heatmap
)

annotation_gene_df$`Sig. Inflix vs Ipi-Nivo` <- create_significance_column(
  all_p_values_df, "P_Value_Wilcoxon_Infliximab_vs_Ipi.Nivo", genes_in_heatmap
)

for (col_name in colnames(annotation_gene_df)) {
  if (is.logical(annotation_gene_df[[col_name]])) {
    annotation_gene_df[[col_name]] <- factor(
      ifelse(annotation_gene_df[[col_name]], "Oui", "Non"), 
      levels = c("Non", "Oui") 
    )
  }
}

annotation_gene_df <- annotation_gene_df[rownames(heatmap_matrix_ordered), , drop = FALSE]

annotation_colors_rows <- list(
  `Sig. Certo vs Inflix` = c("Non" = "lightgrey", "Oui" = "yellow"), # "Non" doit être le premier niveau
  `Sig. Certo vs Ipi-Nivo` = c("Non" = "lightgrey", "Oui" = "yellow"),
  `Sig. Inflix vs Ipi-Nivo` = c("Non" = "lightgrey", "Oui" = "yellow")
)

annotation_colors <- list(
  Traitement = c("Certolizumab" = "#5f4a95", "Infliximab" = "#4570b6", "Ipi-Nivo" = "#46b9ab"),
  Reponse = c("R" = "darkgreen", "NR" = "darkred")
)

annotation_colors_all <- c(annotation_colors, annotation_colors_rows)

colors <- rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu"))
colors.use <- colorRampPalette(colors)(100)

scaled_heatmap_matrix <- t(scale(t(heatmap_matrix_ordered)))

my_breaks <- c(
  seq(min(scaled_heatmap_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)+2, 0, length.out = 51),
  seq(0.001, max(scaled_heatmap_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)-2, length.out = 50)
)

P_heatmap_obj <- pheatmap(
  scaled_heatmap_matrix,
  color = colors.use,
  breaks = my_breaks,
  cluster_rows = TRUE, 
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  annotation_col = annotation_patient_df_ordered,
  annotation_row = annotation_gene_df, 
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors_all, 
  main = "Expression des Gènes (Z-score logFC S6 vs S1) par Patient et Significativité",
  fontsize_row = 8,
  fontsize_col = 8,
  gaps_col = cumsum(table(annotation_patient_df_ordered$Traitement))[1:(length(desired_treatment_order)-1)]
)
print(P_heatmap_obj)
```

<br>

In this analysis we infered transcription factor (TF) activities from CD8 cells using a pseudo-bulk approach. We grouped cells by cluster, treatment, response, and timepoint, then computed weighted mean TF activity scores across conditions. We selected top TFs with the largest variation between S1 and S6, focusing in particular on IRF and STAT family. Finally, we built a heatmap of S6–S1 activity differences, annotated by treatment and patient response, and complemented with Wilcoxon tests to highlight treatment-specific significant changes.

```{r Fig.2.i, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 4}
###
CD8 <- readRDS("/home/etienne.leclercq/Bureau/Etienne_SC/UNIFICATION_TICIMEL_MELANF/DATA/CD8_SCSE.rds")

path_figures <- "/home/etienne.leclercq/Bureau/Etienne_SC/UNIFICATION_TICIMEL_MELANF/POST-SCSE/CD8/FIGURES/PROGENY_Et_Autres/TFs/"

net <- get_collectri(organism = 'human', split_complexes = FALSE)

meta <- CD8@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "cell") %>%
  dplyr::select(cell, seurat_clusters = RNA_snn_res.0.2, Traitement, Week)

groups <- meta %>%
  mutate(grp = paste0("C", seurat_clusters, "_", Traitement, "_" , Week)) %>%
  pull(grp) %>%
  unique()

results_pb <- vector("list", length(groups))
names(results_pb) <- groups

for (grp in groups) {
  
  cells_grp <- meta %>% filter(paste0("C", seurat_clusters, "_", Traitement, "_", Week) == grp) %>% pull(cell)
  sub       <- subset(CD8, cells = cells_grp)
 
  mat_norm  <- GetAssayData(sub, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")
  pb_vec    <- Matrix::rowSums(mat_norm)  # pseudo-bulk par somme
  pb_mat    <- matrix(pb_vec, ncol = 1, dimnames = list(names(pb_vec), grp))
  
  acts_pb   <- run_wmean(
    mat     = as.matrix(pb_mat),
    net     = net,
    .source = "source",
    .target = "target",
    .mor    = "mor",
    times   = 100,
    minsize = 5
  )
  
  results_pb[[grp]] <- acts_pb
}

actsW_pseudobulk <- bind_rows(results_pb, .id = "pseudo_bulk_group") %>%
  as_tibble()

acts_norm <- actsW_pseudobulk %>%
  filter(statistic == "norm_wmean") %>%
  mutate(condition = str_remove(pseudo_bulk_group, "_S[0-9]+$"),
         week = str_extract(pseudo_bulk_group, "S[0-9]+"))

top_TFs_per_condition <- acts_norm %>%
  dplyr::select(source, score, condition, week) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = week, values_from = score) %>%
  filter(!is.na(S1) & !is.na(S6)) %>%
  mutate(var = abs(S6 - S1)) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = var, n = 5) %>%
  ungroup()

selected_TFsBASE <- unique(top_TFs_per_condition$source)

###

CD8 <- readRDS("/home/etienne.leclercq/Bureau/Etienne_SC/UNIFICATION_TICIMEL_MELANF/DATA/CD8_SCSE.rds")

CD8 <- subset(CD8, RNA_snn_res.0.2 =="2")
CD8 <- subset(CD8, orig.ident == "M28", invert = TRUE)

net <- get_collectri(organism = 'human', split_complexes = FALSE)

meta <- CD8@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "cell") %>%
  dplyr::select(cell, seurat_clusters = RNA_snn_res.0.2, Traitement, Week, orig.ident, Reponse)

groups <- meta %>%
  mutate(grp = paste0("C", seurat_clusters, "_",orig.ident, "_", Traitement, "_", Reponse, "_" , Week)) %>%
  pull(grp) %>%
  unique()

results_pb <- vector("list", length(groups))
names(results_pb) <- groups

for (grp in groups) {
  
  
  cells_grp <- meta %>% filter(paste0("C", seurat_clusters, "_",orig.ident, "_", Traitement, "_", Reponse, "_" , Week) == grp) %>% pull(cell)
  sub       <- subset(CD8, cells = cells_grp)
 
  mat_norm  <- GetAssayData(sub, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")
  pb_vec    <- Matrix::rowSums(mat_norm)  
  pb_mat    <- matrix(pb_vec, ncol = 1, dimnames = list(names(pb_vec), grp))
  
  acts_pb   <- run_wmean(
    mat     = as.matrix(pb_mat),
    net     = net,
    .source = "source",
    .target = "target",
    .mor    = "mor",
    times   = 100,
    minsize = 5
  )
  
  results_pb[[grp]] <- acts_pb
}

actsW_pseudobulk <- bind_rows(results_pb, .id = "pseudo_bulk_group") %>%
  as_tibble()


acts_norm <- actsW_pseudobulk %>%
  filter(statistic == "norm_wmean") %>%
  mutate(condition = str_remove(pseudo_bulk_group, "_S[0-9]+$"),
         week = str_extract(pseudo_bulk_group, "S[0-9]+"))

top_TFs_per_condition <- acts_norm %>%
  dplyr::select(source, score, condition, week) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = week, values_from = score) %>%
  filter(!is.na(S1) & !is.na(S6)) %>%
  mutate(var = abs(S6 - S1)) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = var, n = 5) %>%
  ungroup()

selected_TFs <- unique(top_TFs_per_condition$source)

tf_scores_s6_minus_s1 <- acts_norm %>%
  filter(source %in% selected_TFsBASE, week %in% c("S1", "S6")) %>%

  pivot_wider(
    names_from = week,   
    values_from = score, 
    id_cols = c(condition, source) 
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(score_S6_minus_S1 = abs(S6 - S1)) %>%
  
  dplyr::select(condition, source, S1, S6, score_S6_minus_S1, everything()) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Traitement = str_match(condition, "^C2_[TM]\\d+_([^_]+)")[,2],
    Reponse    = str_match(condition, "^C2_[TM]\\d+_[^_]+_([^_]+)$")[,2]
  )


tf_scores_s6_minus_s1 <- drop_na(tf_scores_s6_minus_s1)

ordre_traitements <- c("Ipi-Nivo", "Certolizumab", "Infliximab") 
tf_scores_s6_minus_s1$Traitement <- factor(tf_scores_s6_minus_s1$Traitement, levels = ordre_traitements)

tf_scores_s6_minus_s1$Reponse <- factor(tf_scores_s6_minus_s1$Reponse)

tf_scores_s6_minus_s1 <- tf_scores_s6_minus_s1 %>%
  filter(source %in% c("IRF1", "IRF2", "IRF3", "STAT1"))

heatmap_data_wide <- tf_scores_s6_minus_s1 %>%
  dplyr::select(condition, source, score_S6_minus_S1) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = condition,      
    values_from = score_S6_minus_S1 
  )

heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_data_wide %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "source") %>% 
  as.matrix()

wilcox_results_list <- list()

unique_sources <- unique(tf_scores_s6_minus_s1$source)

for (gene_name in unique_sources) {
  cat(paste0("  Gène : ", gene_name, "\n"))
  
  gene_data_for_test <- tf_scores_s6_minus_s1 %>%
    filter(source == gene_name)
  
  treatments_for_gene <- unique(gene_data_for_test$Traitement)
  
  if (length(treatments_for_gene) < 2) {
    cat(paste0("    Pas assez de traitements différents pour le gène ", gene_name, ". Skipping.\n"))
    next
  }
  
  treatment_pairs <- combn(treatments_for_gene, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  
  gene_p_values <- data.frame()
  
  for (pair in treatment_pairs) {
    trt1 <- pair[1]
    trt2 <- pair[2]
    
    data_trt1 <- gene_data_for_test %>%
      filter(Traitement == trt1) %>%
      pull(score_S6_minus_S1)
    
    data_trt2 <- gene_data_for_test %>%
      filter(Traitement == trt2) %>%
      pull(score_S6_minus_S1)
    
    if (length(data_trt1) > 0 && length(data_trt2) > 0) {
      test_result <- tryCatch({
        wilcox.test(data_trt1, data_trt2)
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat(paste0("    Erreur pour ", gene_name, " (", trt1, " vs ", trt2, "): ", e$message, "\n"))
        list(p.value = NA_real_)
      })
      
      gene_p_values <- bind_rows(gene_p_values, tibble(
        group1 = trt1,
        group2 = trt2,
        p = test_result$p.value 
      ))
    } else {
      cat(paste0("    Données insuffisantes pour la comparaison ", trt1, " vs ", trt2, " pour le gène ", gene_name, ". Skipping.\n"))
    }
  }
  
  if (nrow(gene_p_values) > 0) {
    gene_p_values$gene <- gene_name 
    wilcox_results_list[[gene_name]] <- gene_p_values
  } else {
    cat(paste0("    Aucune p-value calculée pour le gène ", gene_name, ".\n"))
  }
}

wilcox_all_results_base <- bind_rows(wilcox_results_list)

significance_threshold <- 0.05

wilcox_all_results_base <- wilcox_all_results_base %>%
  mutate(comparison_id = paste0(group1, "_vs_", group2))

annotation_df_wide <- wilcox_all_results_base %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, comparison_id, p) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = comparison_id,
    values_from = p,
    values_fill = NA_real_ 
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Certolizumab_vs_") | starts_with("Infliximab_vs_") | starts_with("Adalimumab_vs_"),
                ~ ifelse(.x < significance_threshold, "oui", "non"))) 

unique_sources_all <- unique(tf_scores_s6_minus_s1$source) 
final_row_annotation_multi_col <- tibble(source = unique_sources_all) %>%
  left_join(annotation_df_wide, by = c("source" = "gene")) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Certolizumab_vs_") | starts_with("Infliximab_vs_"),
                ~ replace_na(.x, "non"))) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "source") 

for (col_name in colnames(final_row_annotation_multi_col)) {
  final_row_annotation_multi_col[[col_name]] <- factor(final_row_annotation_multi_col[[col_name]], levels = c("non", "oui"))
}

heatmap_matrix <- tf_scores_s6_minus_s1 %>%
  dplyr::select(condition, source, score_S6_minus_S1) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = condition,
    values_from = score_S6_minus_S1
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "source") %>%
  as.matrix()

column_info <- tf_scores_s6_minus_s1 %>%
  distinct(condition, Traitement, Reponse) %>%
  filter(condition %in% colnames(heatmap_matrix)) %>%
  arrange(Traitement) 

ordered_colnames <- column_info$condition
if(length(ordered_colnames) == 0 || !all(ordered_colnames %in% colnames(heatmap_matrix))) {
  warning("Les noms de colonnes triés ne correspondent pas entièrement aux noms de colonnes de la matrice de la heatmap. Vérifiez les conditions et traitements.")
  heatmap_matrix_ordered <- heatmap_matrix
  annotation_col_df <- data.frame(Traitement = rep("Unknown", ncol(heatmap_matrix)), row.names = colnames(heatmap_matrix))
} else {
  heatmap_matrix_ordered <- heatmap_matrix[, ordered_colnames, drop = FALSE]
  annotation_col_df <- column_info %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "condition") %>%
    dplyr::select(Traitement,Reponse)
}

ann_colors_rows_list <- list()
for (col_name in colnames(final_row_annotation_multi_col)) {
  ann_colors_rows_list[[col_name]] <- c("oui" = "yellow", "non" = "lightgrey") 
}

annotation_colors <- list(
  Traitement = c("Certolizumab" = "#5f4a95", "Infliximab" = "#4570b6", "Ipi-Nivo" = "#46b9ab"),
  Reponse = c("R" = "darkgreen", "NR" = "darkred")
)

all_ann_colors <- c(ann_colors_rows_list, annotation_colors)


scaled_matrix <- t(scale(t(heatmap_matrix_ordered), center = TRUE))

max_abs_val <- max(abs(scaled_matrix), na.rm = TRUE)

breaks_list <- seq(-max_abs_val, max_abs_val, length.out = 101) 

color_palette <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "RdBu")))(100) 

desired_treatment_order <- c("Certolizumab", "Infliximab", "Ipi-Nivo")

annotation_col_df$Traitement <- factor(
  annotation_col_df$Traitement,
  levels = desired_treatment_order
)

annotation_col_df$Reponse <- as.character(annotation_col_df$Reponse)

annotation_col_df <- annotation_col_df %>%
  mutate(Reponse = ifelse(grepl("T5", rownames(annotation_col_df)), "R", Reponse))

annotation_col_df$Reponse <- factor(annotation_col_df$Reponse, levels = c("R", "NR"))

ordered_colnames <- rownames(annotation_col_df)[
  order(annotation_col_df$Traitement)
]

heatmap_matrix_ordered <- heatmap_matrix[, ordered_colnames, drop = FALSE]

annotation_col_df_ordered <- annotation_col_df[ordered_colnames, , drop = FALSE]

cols_per_trt <- table(annotation_col_df_ordered$Traitement)[desired_treatment_order]
gaps_positions <- c(7,15)

pheatmap(
  mat            = scaled_matrix,              
  color          = color_palette,
  breaks         = breaks_list,
  cluster_rows   = FALSE,
  cluster_cols   = FALSE,                      
  show_rownames  = TRUE,
  show_colnames  = TRUE,
  annotation_row = final_row_annotation_multi_col,
  annotation_col = annotation_col_df_ordered,
  annotation_colors = all_ann_colors,
  gaps_col       = gaps_positions,             
  fontsize_row   = 8,
  fontsize_col   = 8,
  main           = "Scores S6-S1 par condition et gène (Centré sur 0)"
  
)
```

```{r Extended data Fig.2.b, fig.width=9, fig.height=2, warning=F}
CD8 <- readRDS("/home/etienne.leclercq/Bureau/Etienne_SC/UNIFICATION_TICIMEL_MELANF/DATA/CD8_SCSE.rds")
  
CD8$Cluster_Rep <- paste(CD8$Reponse, CD8$Week, sep = "_")
CD8$Traitement_Week <- paste(CD8$Traitement, CD8$Week, sep = "_")

ppt <- CD8@meta.data %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Name, cca_clusters, Cluster_Rep, Traitement) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Name, Cluster_Rep,Traitement) %>%
  summarise(freq = n / sum(n), cca_clusters) %>%
  as.data.frame()

ppt <- ppt %>%
  mutate(Type = case_when(
    cca_clusters == 6 ~ "Cluster6"))

ppt$Traitement_Cluster <- paste0(ppt$Traitement, "_", ppt$cca_clusters)

ppt$Traitement_Cluster <- factor(ppt$Traitement_Cluster, levels = c(
  "Certolizumab_6", "Infliximab_6", "Ipi-Nivo_6"))

ppt$group <- substr(ppt$Name, 1, 3)
ppt <- dplyr::mutate(ppt, Patient = as.factor(group))

ppt <- drop_na(ppt)

color_map <- c(
  "Certolizumab" = "#5f4a95",
  "Infliximab"  = "#4570b6",
  "Ipi-Nivo"    = "#46b9ab"
)

all_plots <- list()

for (cluster in unique(ppt$cca_clusters)) {
  for (traitement in unique(ppt$Traitement)) {
    
    filtered_data <- ppt %>%
      filter(cca_clusters == cluster & Traitement == traitement)
    
    filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
      mutate(Cluster_Rep_Simplified = case_when(
        str_detect(Cluster_Rep, "S1") ~ "S1",
        str_detect(Cluster_Rep, "S6") ~ "S6",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )) %>%
      filter(!is.na(Cluster_Rep_Simplified))
    
    p_value <- if (all(c("S1", "S6") %in% filtered_data$Cluster_Rep_Simplified)) {
      wilcox.test(
        filtered_data$freq[filtered_data$Cluster_Rep_Simplified == "S1"],
        filtered_data$freq[filtered_data$Cluster_Rep_Simplified == "S6"],
        exact = FALSE
      )$p.value
    } else {
      NA
    }
    
    title <- paste0("Cluster ", cluster, " - ", traitement, ": ", 
                    ifelse(!is.na(p_value) & p_value < 0.05, "*", "ns"))
    
    plot <- ggplot(filtered_data, aes(
      x = Cluster_Rep_Simplified,
      y = freq,
      color = Traitement,     
      group = Patient         
    )) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_line() +
      scale_color_manual(values = color_map) +  
      labs(title = title, x = "Cluster Rep (Simplified)", y = "Frequency") +
      ylim(0, 0.2) +
      theme_my() +
      theme(legend.position = "none")
    
    all_plots[[paste0("Cluster_", cluster, "_", traitement)]] <- plot
  }
}

combined_plot <- wrap_plots(all_plots, ncol = 4)

print(combined_plot)


```

```{r Extended data Fig.2.c/d/e}
for(condi in condition){
  print(condi)
  Idents(CD8)=CD8$condition

marks=FindMarkers(CD8,ident.1 =condi[[1]],ident.2 = condi[2:length(condi)] ) %>% rownames_to_column("Gene") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj<0.01,(pct.1>0.2|pct.2>0.2),abs(avg_log2FC)>0.5) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(diff=pct.1-pct.2)
  
bgset=rownames(CD8)[rowSums(CD8[["RNA"]]$counts)>0]

pp=lapply(Pathways, function(x){
  
  pathways.hallmark <- fgsea::gmtPathways(x)

  
  orr=fgsea::fora(pathways = pathways.hallmark,genes=marks$Gene,universe = bgset) %>% dplyr::filter(padj<0.01) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-overlapGenes)
  

  return(orr)

})

dat=Reduce(rbind,pp) %>% dplyr::arrange((padj))

plt=dat %>% dplyr::arrange((padj)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(pathway=factor(pathway,levels=rev(pathway)),
                GeneRatio=overlap/size)
  


ggplot(plt[1:10,] %>%
              dplyr::mutate(pathway=str_replace_all(pathway,"_"," ")) %>% 
              dplyr::mutate(pathway=factor(pathway,levels=rev(pathway))),aes(x=-log10(padj),y=pathway,color=-log10(padj)))+
  geom_point(aes(size = GeneRatio), alpha = 0.5)+
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0.15))) +
  scale_size(
    range = c(3, 13),
    limits = c(0, 1) 
  ) + xlab("-log10(adjusted p-value)") +
  theme_my()+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+
  scale_y_discrete(labels = scales::label_wrap(30))

}
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
  Idents(pbmc)=pbmc$condition

  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj<0.01,(pct.1>0.2|pct.2>0.2),abs(avg_log2FC)>0.5) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(diff=pct.1-pct.2)
  
bgset=rownames(pbmc)[rowSums(pbmc[["RNA"]]$counts)>0]

pp=lapply(Pathways, function(x){
  
  pathways.hallmark <- fgsea::gmtPathways(x)

  
  orr=fgsea::fora(pathways = pathways.hallmark,genes=marks$Gene,universe = bgset) %>% dplyr::filter(padj<0.01) %>% 
    dplyr::select(-overlapGenes)
  

  return(orr)

})

pp <- lapply(Pathways, function(x) {
  pathways <- fgsea::gmtPathways(x)
  fgsea::fora(pathways = pathways,
              genes    = marks$Gene,
              universe = bgset) %>%
    filter(padj < 0.01)
})

dat <- bind_rows(pp) %>%
  arrange(padj)

plt <- dat %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  
  mutate(
    geneList = overlapGenes %>%
      str_remove_all("^c\\(") %>%      
      str_remove_all("\\)$") %>%       
      str_remove_all('\\"') %>%        
      str_split(",\\s*")               
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    overlapPos = map(geneList, ~ keep(.x,  ~ {
      idx <- match(.x, marks$Gene)
      !is.na(idx) && marks$avg_log2FC[idx] > 0
    })),
    overlapNeg = map(geneList, ~ keep(.x,  ~ {
      idx <- match(.x, marks$Gene)
      !is.na(idx) && marks$avg_log2FC[idx] < 0
    }))
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    overlapGenes = map_chr(geneList, paste, collapse = ";"),
    overlapPos   = map_chr(overlapPos,   paste, collapse = ";"),
    overlapNeg   = map_chr(overlapNeg,   paste, collapse = ";")
  ) %>%
  
  arrange(padj) %>%
  mutate(
    pathway   = factor(pathway, levels = rev(pathway)),
    rank      = row_number(),
    GeneRatio = overlap / size
  )

plt_to_export <- plt %>% 
  dplyr::select(-geneList)

stopifnot(all(!map_lgl(plt_to_export, is.list)))

write.table(plt_to_export,file      = paste0(path_figures, "/ORA_RESULTS_", condi[[1]], "_vs_", condi[[2]], ".txt"),  quote     = FALSE,  sep       = "\t",  row.names = FALSE)
  
}
```

```{r Extended data Fig.3.f}
    ) %>%

CD8@assays$RNA$counts <- CD8@assays$RNA$counts[genes_to_keep, ]
universe_genes <- rownames(CD8@assays$RNA$counts)
N <- length(universe_genes)

dat <- dat %>%
  left_join(pathway_theoretical_sizes, by = "pathway") %>%
  mutate(N = N) 

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    x = as.numeric(overlap), 
    M = as.numeric(size)     
  ) %>%
  mutate(FE = (x / k) / (M / N))


dat_radar <- dat %>%
  dplyr::select(pathway, Traitement, Classe, FE)

pathways_with_classes <- dat_radar %>%
  distinct(pathway, Classe) %>%
  arrange(Classe, pathway)

ordered_pathways <- pathways_with_classes$pathway

df_radar_wide <- dat_radar %>%
  dplyr::select(pathway, Traitement, FE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = pathway, values_from = FE) %>%
  rename(group = Traitement)

df_radar_wide <- df_radar_wide %>%
  mutate(across(-group, ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))

cols_to_transform_and_normalize <- names(df_radar_wide)[names(df_radar_wide) != "group"]

df_radar_transformed_normalized <- df_radar_wide %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cols_to_transform_and_normalize), ~ {
    transformed_values <- log2(. + 1) 
    
    min_val_transformed <- 0
    max_val_transformed <- max(transformed_values, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    if (min_val_transformed == max_val_transformed) {
      return(0.5)
    } else {
      return((transformed_values - min_val_transformed) / (max_val_transformed - min_val_transformed))
    }
  }))

df_radar_final <- df_radar_transformed_normalized %>%
  dplyr::select(group, all_of(ordered_pathways))

couleurs_traitements <- c(
  "Infliximab" = "#4570b6",
  "Certolizumab" = "#5f4a95",
  "IpiNivo" = "#46b9ab"
)

df_long <- df_radar_final %>%
  rename(Traitement = group) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Traitement,
    names_to = "Pathway",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Pathway = str_replace_all(Pathway, "_", " "),
    Pathway = str_wrap(Pathway, width = 30) 
  ) %>%
  mutate(Traitement = factor(Traitement, levels = names(couleurs_traitements))) %>%
  mutate(Pathway = factor(Pathway, levels = rev(unique(Pathway))))


plot_radar_values <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Value, y = Pathway, fill = Traitement)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
    expand = c(0.01, 0.01)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = couleurs_traitements) +
  labs(
    title = "Valeurs des Pathways par Traitement",
    x = "Fold Enrichment",
    y = "Pathways"
  ) +
  theme_my() + 
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

ggsave("radar_pathway_values_barplot_Cluster1.svg", path = path_figures, plot = plot_radar_values, width = 6, height = 12, dpi = 500)
```

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
unique_classes <- unique(dat$Classe)

for (current_class in unique_classes) {
  message(paste0("Traitement de la classe : ", current_class))

  all_top_pathways_for_class <- dat %>%
    filter(Classe == current_class)

  all_genes_for_class <- all_top_pathways_for_class %>%
    pull(overlapGenes) %>%
    str_split(";") %>%
    unlist() %>%
    unique() %>%
    as.character()

  genes_to_analyze_current_class <- all_genes_for_class[all_genes_for_class %in% rownames(CD8@assays$RNA$data)]

  if (length(genes_to_analyze_current_class) == 0) {
    warning(paste0("Aucun gène de la classe '", current_class, "' n'a été trouvé dans l'objet Seurat. Skipping cette classe."))
    next 
  }

  logFC_patient_gene_data <- tibble()
  patients_unique <- unique(CD8@meta.data$orig.ident) 

  for (patient_id in patients_unique) {
    cells_s1 <- CD8@meta.data %>% filter(orig.ident == patient_id, Week == "S1") 
    cells_s6 <- CD8@meta.data %>% filter(orig.ident == patient_id, Week == "S6") 

    if (length(cells_s1) > 0 && length(cells_s6) > 0) {
      expr_s1 <- Seurat::GetAssayData(CD8, slot = "data")[genes_to_analyze_current_class, cells_s1, drop = FALSE]
      expr_s6 <- Seurat::GetAssayData(CD8, slot = "data")[genes_to_analyze_current_class, cells_s6, drop = FALSE]

      if(nrow(expr_s1) == 0 || nrow(expr_s6) == 0) {
          warning(paste0("Pas de données d'expression pour les gènes de la classe '", current_class, "' pour le patient ", patient_id, ". Skipping patient."))
          next
      }

      mean_expr_s1 <- rowMeans(expr_s1)
      mean_expr_s6 <- rowMeans(expr_s6)

      logFC_val <- mean_expr_s6 / mean_expr_s1 

      patient_treatment <- CD8@meta.data %>%
        filter(orig.ident == patient_id) %>%
        dplyr::pull(Traitement) %>%
        unique()

      if (length(patient_treatment) == 1) {
        temp_df <- tibble(
          Gene = genes_to_analyze_current_class,
          Patient = patient_id,
          Traitement = patient_treatment,
          LogFC_S6_S1 = logFC_val
        )
        logFC_patient_gene_data <- bind_rows(logFC_patient_gene_data, temp_df)
      } else {
        warning(paste("Problème avec le traitement du patient:", patient_id, ". Plusieurs ou aucun traitement trouvé."))
      }
    } else {
      warning(paste("Données S1 ou S6 manquantes ou insuffisantes pour le patient:", patient_id, ". Patient ignoré pour l'analyse des logFC."))
    }
  }

  if (nrow(logFC_patient_gene_data) == 0) {
    warning(paste0("Aucune donnée de logFC n'a pu être calculée pour la classe '", current_class, "'. Skipping cette classe."))
    next
  }

  mean_logFC_by_treatment <- logFC_patient_gene_data %>%
    group_by(Gene, Traitement) %>%
    summarise(Mean_LogFC = mean(LogFC_S6_S1, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Traitement, values_from = Mean_LogFC,
                names_prefix = "Mean_LogFC_") 

  logFC_by_patient <- logFC_patient_gene_data %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene, Patient, LogFC_S6_S1) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Patient, values_from = LogFC_S6_S1,
                names_prefix = "LogFC_Patient_")    

  treatments <- unique(logFC_patient_gene_data$Traitement)
  comparison_pairs <- combn(treatments, 2, simplify = FALSE)

  p_value_results <- tibble(Gene = genes_to_analyze_current_class)

  for (gene in genes_to_analyze_current_class) {
    gene_data <- logFC_patient_gene_data %>% filter(Gene == gene)

    for (pair in comparison_pairs) {
      trt1 <- pair[1]
      trt2 <- pair[2]

      data_trt1 <- gene_data %>% filter(Traitement == trt1) %>% pull(LogFC_S6_S1)
      data_trt2 <- gene_data %>% filter(Traitement == trt2) %>% pull(LogFC_S6_S1)

      if (length(data_trt1[!is.na(data_trt1)]) > 1 && length(data_trt2[!is.na(data_trt2)]) > 1) {
        test_result <- wilcox.test(data_trt1, data_trt2)
        col_name <- paste0("P_Value_Wilcoxon_", trt1, "_vs_", trt2)
        p_value_results[p_value_results$Gene == gene, col_name] <- test_result$p.value
      } else {
        col_name <- paste0("P_Value_Wilcoxon_", trt1, "_vs_", trt2)
        p_value_results[p_value_results$Gene == gene, col_name] <- NA
      }
    }
  }

  final_table <- mean_logFC_by_treatment %>%
    left_join(logFC_by_patient, by = "Gene") %>%
    left_join(p_value_results, by = "Gene") %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene, starts_with("Mean_LogFC_"), starts_with("P_Value_Wilcoxon_"), starts_with("LogFC_Patient_"))

  output_filename <- paste0("Resume_Genes_", current_class, "_Comparaisons_Traitements_C1.xlsx")
  write.xlsx(final_table, file.path(path_figures, output_filename), rowNames = FALSE)

  message(paste("Le tableau pour la classe '", current_class, "' a été exporté avec succès vers:", file.path(path_figures, output_filename)))
}
```

```{r Extended data Fig.3.g, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
create_significance_column <- function(data_p_values, p_value_col_name, genes_to_annotate, threshold = 0.05) {
  sig_vector <- rep(FALSE, length(genes_to_annotate))
  names(sig_vector) <- genes_to_annotate

  significant_genes_from_source <- data_p_values %>%
    filter(get(p_value_col_name) < threshold) %>%
    pull(Gene)

  sig_vector[genes_to_annotate %in% significant_genes_from_source] <- TRUE

  return(sig_vector)
}
```

```{r Extended data Fig.3.h}
CD8 <- readRDS("/home/etienne.leclercq/Bureau/Etienne_SC/UNIFICATION_TICIMEL_MELANF/DATA/CD4_SCSE.rds")

CD8 <- subset(CD8, RNA_snn_res.0.2 =="1")

net <- get_collectri(organism = 'human', split_complexes = FALSE)

meta <- CD8@meta.data %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "cell") %>%
  dplyr::select(cell, seurat_clusters = RNA_snn_res.0.2, Traitement, Week, orig.ident, Reponse)

groups <- meta %>%
  mutate(grp = paste0("C", seurat_clusters, "_",orig.ident, "_", Traitement, "_", Reponse, "_" , Week)) %>%
  pull(grp) %>%
  unique()

results_pb <- vector("list", length(groups))
names(results_pb) <- groups

for (grp in groups) {
  
  cells_grp <- meta %>% filter(paste0("C", seurat_clusters, "_",orig.ident, "_", Traitement, "_", Reponse, "_" , Week) == grp) %>% pull(cell)
  sub       <- subset(CD8, cells = cells_grp)
 
  mat_norm  <- GetAssayData(sub, assay = "RNA", slot = "data")
  pb_vec    <- Matrix::rowSums(mat_norm)  
  pb_mat    <- matrix(pb_vec, ncol = 1, dimnames = list(names(pb_vec), grp))
  
  acts_pb   <- run_wmean(
    mat     = as.matrix(pb_mat),
    net     = net,
    .source = "source",
    .target = "target",
    .mor    = "mor",
    times   = 100,
    minsize = 5
  )
  
  results_pb[[grp]] <- acts_pb
}

actsW_pseudobulk <- bind_rows(results_pb, .id = "pseudo_bulk_group") %>%
  as_tibble()


acts_norm <- actsW_pseudobulk %>%
  filter(statistic == "norm_wmean") %>%
  mutate(condition = str_remove(pseudo_bulk_group, "_S[0-9]+$"),
         week = str_extract(pseudo_bulk_group, "S[0-9]+"))


selected_TFs <- c("IRF1", "IRF2", "IRF3", "STAT1","TBX21")

tf_scores_s6_minus_s1 <- acts_norm %>%
  filter(source %in% selected_TFs, week %in% c("S1", "S6")) %>%

  pivot_wider(
    names_from = week,   
    values_from = score, 
    id_cols = c(condition, source) 
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(score_S6_minus_S1 = abs(S6 - S1)) %>%
  
  dplyr::select(condition, source, S1, S6, score_S6_minus_S1, everything()) %>%
  
  mutate(
    Traitement = str_match(condition, "^C\\d+_[TM]\\d+_([^_]+)")[,2],
    Reponse    = str_match(condition, "^C\\d+_[TM]\\d+_[^_]+_([^_]+)$")[,2]
  )


tf_scores_s6_minus_s1 <- drop_na(tf_scores_s6_minus_s1)

ordre_traitements <- c("Ipi-Nivo", "Certolizumab", "Infliximab") 
tf_scores_s6_minus_s1$Traitement <- factor(tf_scores_s6_minus_s1$Traitement, levels = ordre_traitements)

tf_scores_s6_minus_s1$Reponse <- factor(tf_scores_s6_minus_s1$Reponse)

tf_scores_s6_minus_s1 <- tf_scores_s6_minus_s1 %>%
  filter(source %in% c("IRF1", "IRF2", "IRF3", "STAT1","TBX21"))

heatmap_data_wide <- tf_scores_s6_minus_s1 %>%
  dplyr::select(condition, source, score_S6_minus_S1) %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = condition,      
    values_from = score_S6_minus_S1 
  )

heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_data_wide %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "source") %>% 
  as.matrix()

wilcox_results_list <- list()

unique_sources <- unique(tf_scores_s6_minus_s1$source)

for (gene_name in unique_sources) {
  cat(paste0("  Gène : ", gene_name, "\n"))
  
  gene_data_for_test <- tf_scores_s6_minus_s1 %>%
    filter(source == gene_name)
  
  treatments_for_gene <- unique(gene_data_for_test$Traitement)
  
  if (length(treatments_for_gene) < 2) {
    cat(paste0("    Pas assez de traitements différents pour le gène ", gene_name, ". Skipping.\n"))
    next
  }
  
  treatment_pairs <- combn(treatments_for_gene, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  
  gene_p_values <- data.frame()
  
  for (pair in treatment_pairs) {
    trt1 <- pair[1]
    trt2 <- pair[2]
    
    data_trt1 <- gene_data_for_test %>%
      filter(Traitement == trt1) %>%
      pull(score_S6_minus_S1)
    
    data_trt2 <- gene_data_for_test %>%
      filter(Traitement == trt2) %>%
      pull(score_S6_minus_S1)
    
    if (length(data_trt1) > 0 && length(data_trt2) > 0) {
      test_result <- tryCatch({
        wilcox.test(data_trt1, data_trt2)
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat(paste0("    Erreur pour ", gene_name, " (", trt1, " vs ", trt2, "): ", e$message, "\n"))
        list(p.value = NA_real_)
      })
      
      gene_p_values <- bind_rows(gene_p_values, tibble(
        group1 = trt1,
        group2 = trt2,
        p = test_result$p.value 
      ))
    } else {
      cat(paste0("    Données insuffisantes pour la comparaison ", trt1, " vs ", trt2, " pour le gène ", gene_name, ". Skipping.\n"))
    }
  }
  
  if (nrow(gene_p_values) > 0) {
    gene_p_values$gene <- gene_name 
    wilcox_results_list[[gene_name]] <- gene_p_values
  } else {
    cat(paste0("    Aucune p-value calculée pour le gène ", gene_name, ".\n"))
  }
}

wilcox_all_results_base <- bind_rows(wilcox_results_list)

significance_threshold <- 0.05

wilcox_all_results_base <- wilcox_all_results_base %>%
  mutate(comparison_id = paste0(group1, "_vs_", group2))

annotation_df_wide <- wilcox_all_results_base %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, comparison_id, p) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = comparison_id,
    values_from = p,
    values_fill = NA_real_ 
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Certolizumab_vs_") | starts_with("Infliximab_vs_") | starts_with("Adalimumab_vs_"),
                ~ ifelse(.x < significance_threshold, "oui", "non"))) 

unique_sources_all <- unique(tf_scores_s6_minus_s1$source) 
final_row_annotation_multi_col <- tibble(source = unique_sources_all) %>%
  left_join(annotation_df_wide, by = c("source" = "gene")) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Certolizumab_vs_") | starts_with("Infliximab_vs_"),
                ~ replace_na(.x, "non"))) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "source") 

for (col_name in colnames(final_row_annotation_multi_col)) {
  final_row_annotation_multi_col[[col_name]] <- factor(final_row_annotation_multi_col[[col_name]], levels = c("non", "oui"))
}

heatmap_matrix <- tf_scores_s6_minus_s1 %>%
  dplyr::select(condition, source, score_S6_minus_S1) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = condition,
    values_from = score_S6_minus_S1
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "source") %>%

column_info <- tf_scores_s6_minus_s1 %>%

ordered_colnames <- column_info$condition
if(length(ordered_colnames) == 0 || !all(ordered_colnames %in% colnames(heatmap_matrix))) {
  warning("Les noms de colonnes triés ne correspondent pas entièrement aux noms de colonnes de la matrice de la heatmap. Vérifiez les conditions et traitements.")
  heatmap_matrix_ordered <- heatmap_matrix
  annotation_col_df <- data.frame(Traitement = rep("Unknown", ncol(heatmap_matrix)), row.names = colnames(heatmap_matrix))
} else {

  annotation_col_df <- column_info %>%

for (col_name in colnames(final_row_annotation_multi_col)) {

}

annotation_colors <- list(

all_ann_colors <- c(ann_colors_rows_list, annotation_colors)


scaled_matrix <- t(scale(t(heatmap_matrix_ordered), center = TRUE))

max_abs_val <- max(abs(scaled_matrix), na.rm = TRUE)

breaks_list <- seq(-max_abs_val, max_abs_val, length.out = 101) 

color_palette <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "RdBu")))(100)

ordered_colnames <- rownames(annotation_col_df)[
  order(annotation_col_df$Traitement)
]

heatmap_matrix_ordered <- heatmap_matrix[, ordered_colnames, drop = FALSE]

annotation_col_df_ordered <- annotation_col_df[ordered_colnames, , drop = FALSE]

cols_per_trt <- table(annotation_col_df_ordered$Traitement)
gaps_positions <- cumsum(cols_per_trt)[1:(length(cols_per_trt) - 1)]

pheatmap(
  mat            = scaled_matrix,              
  color          = color_palette,
  breaks         = breaks_list,
  cluster_rows   = FALSE,
  cluster_cols   = FALSE,                      
  show_rownames  = TRUE,
  show_colnames  = TRUE,
  annotation_row = final_row_annotation_multi_col,
  annotation_col = annotation_col_df_ordered,
  annotation_colors = all_ann_colors,
  gaps_col       = gaps_positions,             
  fontsize_row   = 8,
  fontsize_col   = 8,
  main           = "Scores S6-S1 par condition et gène (Centré sur 0)"
  
)
```

```{r Extended data Fig.4.b}
)

treatments <- annotation_col$Traitement

wilcox_results <- t(apply(mat, 1, function(values) {
  group1 <- values[treatments == "Certolizumab"]
  group2 <- values[treatments == "Infliximab"]
  group3 <- values[treatments == "Ipi-Nivo"]
  
  p1 <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(group1, group2)$p.value, error = function(e) NA)
  p2 <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(group1, group3)$p.value, error = function(e) NA)
  p3 <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(group2, group3)$p.value, error = function(e) NA)
  
  c(Certo_vs_Inflix = p1, Certo_vs_IpiNivo = p2, Inflix_vs_IpiNivo = p3)
}))

wilcox_results <- as.data.frame(wilcox_results)
rownames(wilcox_results) <- rownames(mat)

wilcox_binary <- as.data.frame(lapply(wilcox_results, function(x) ifelse(x < 0.05, "yes", "no")))
rownames(wilcox_binary) <- rownames(mat)
```
